To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the management of group work as a learning tool is influenced by teachers’ presumptions about students’ ability and willingness to work in groups, their mode of procedure, and their reflections regarding the learning outcome of the subject matter.

the teachers’ reluctance to use group work can be explained by the fact that the teachers’ presumptions and the way they work with group work in their teaching are influenced by their mode of procedure.

teachers’ presumption, mode of procedure and reflections regarding subject knowledge, as learning outcomes when using group work as a teaching method, are decisive in their willingness to use this method in the classroom.

the management of group work as a teaching method and how teachers’ presumptions influence their willingness to use this teaching method.
